SELECT cp.category, cp.subcategory, sum(f.quantity) AS units, count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT cp.sku) AS skus
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.quantity) AS units, sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS test_units
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

SELECT cp.subcategory, p.subcategory AS subcat_then, count(*) AS lines, sum(f.quantity) AS units, min(f.quantity), max(f.quantity), count(DISTINCT p.sku) AS skus
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND cp.subcategory IN ('Fixings & Fasteners','Indoor Lighting','Storage Boxes','Plants & Flowers','Cleaning Products')
